facts.subject: The Fremennik Trials: Koschei the deathless, forms 1-3
facts.statement: On Hardcore Worlds a death to Koschei's first, second or third form is an unsafe (run-ending) death. Both Jagex Hardcore Worlds posts list only 'The Fremennik Trials (only the 4th phase of the duel with Koschei the Deathless)' as safe; Hardcore Worlds uses the Hardcore Group Ironman death ruleset. The wiki's Koschei and Fremennik Trials pages say forms 1-3 are safe for regular Hardcore Ironmen, which does not apply here.
facts.caveat: Hardcore Worlds launched 2026-11-04 (16 days before verification): new content whose rules Jagex may still revise; re-check the T1 posts before publishing. The wiki pages contain HCIM-safe wording for forms 1-3 (Koschei rev 15387641 line 226; Fremennik Trials rev 15396092 line 218) that planners must not use. Default UNSAFE applies.

Treat those six as UNSAFE until Jagex confirms them.

My fetch of the same revision (15404671, unchanged today) shows all three listed as SAFE, so that sentence is wrong; the value itself is right. New content (launched 2026-11-04). Last Man Standing cannot be accessed on Hardcore Worlds (OUT TODAY line 217).

facts.subject: Koschei the deathless (The Fremennik Trials)
facts.statement: Koschei's max hits are 3 / 5 / 7 for forms 1-3, each attacking every 4 ticks (2.4 s), with 30 / 50 / 70 Hitpoints. Form 4 hits for at most 1 but every tick (0.6 s), has 255 Hitpoints and 255 Attack: up to 100 damage per minute (computed: 60 s / 0.6 s = 100 hits x 1).
facts.caveat: Second confirmation is partial: the 3/5/7 values appear only on the Koschei page (infobox and its strategy prose, same page); the Fremennik Trials page independently confirms only form 4's 1 damage per tick. No non-wiki source was found. One Koschei-page sentence ('in his third and fourth form he hits progressively harder and quicker') does not match the infobox.

sources.title: Koschei the deathless
sources.quote: His max hits are 3 in his first form, 5 in his second, and 7 in his third.

sources.title: Koschei the deathless
sources.quote: *He is the fastest attacking [[NPC]] in the game (in his final form with an attack speed of 1, meaning every 0.6 seconds), along with [[Scarab swarm]]s. The attack speed for his first three forms is 4 (2.4 seconds), the same as unarmed combat.

sources.title: The Fremennik Trials
sources.quote: The fourth form is the hardest. He will hit once every game tick, but can only hit for 1 damage at a time.

facts.subject: Koschei the deathless, form 4
facts.statement: When Koschei's 4th form starts he drains all your prayer points, then keeps draining them by 1-2 every second, so protection prayers cannot be relied on in form 4.
facts.caveat: Single source for the exact rates (Fremennik Trials walkthrough). The Koschei page change log (6 February 2014: 'Koschei now keeps it drained') supports the drain but gives no numbers.

sources.title: The Fremennik Trials
sources.quote: In this form, Koschei will quickly drop your prayer points in intervals of 1-2 every second and will drop all of your prayer points as soon as the form starts.

sources.quote: |change = After Koschei the Deathless drained your prayer in [[Fremennik Trials]], players could simply restore it and re-activate their prayers. Koschei now keeps it drained.

facts.subject: The Fremennik Trials: Koschei fight arena

value.ring_of_life: teleports you to your respawn point and the fight restarts at form 1
value.phase_timer: 10 minutes in one phase, then Koschei despawns and the fight resets
value.walk_out: not documented (a ladder is mentioned only in an untested aside)

facts.statement: The Koschei fight is in an instance under Thorvald's house. Weapons, armour, fletching materials and runes are not allowed; food, Prayer, god books and jewellery are. A ring of life sends you to your respawn point and you restart at form 1. Spending 10 minutes in one phase makes Koschei disappear and the fight restart. Whether normal teleports or walking out work mid-fight is not documented.

sources.quote: Additionally, if you take too long fighting Koschei (10 minutes in the same phase), he will simply disappear and you will have to start the challenge all over again.

facts.subject: The Fremennik Trials: Koschei fight arena
facts.value: Koschei can be trapped on the far side of a chasm or by the pillars of fire to regenerate. Staying too long makes him reset to form 1. He can be flinched at the torches.
facts.statement: There is no attack safespot (you have no weapons), but you can trap Koschei on the other side of a hole in the floor or by the fire pillars and regenerate. Staying too long makes him disappear and come back in form 1. He can also be flinched from the north or south tile of a torch.

sources.title: The Fremennik Trials
sources.quote: There is no way to safespot him as you have no weapons, but you can trap him over the hole and wait a while for your health to regenerate. However, if you stay there too long, he will disappear and reappear after you run around, back in his first form.

sources.title: Koschei the deathless
sources.quote: It is possible to [[flinch]] Koschei by standing on either the south or north tile of one of the torches in the room while Koschei is east or west of the same torch.

facts.subject: Underground Pass: traps and environment

value.wall_trap_run_through: percentage of current HP (as low as 3); standing in front repeatedly hits very fast and could be fatal
value.iban_spikes: about 5-8 each, rapid, not blocked by prayer, stun and send you back to the entrance
value.teleport: instant teleports work to leave the dungeon
value.death_penalty_note: dying during the doll step means running the whole dungeon again

facts.statement: Underground Pass damage outside fights: grid-puzzle pits always deal 15; wall traps 5-14 on a failed disarm; running through a wall trap hits a percentage of current HP (as low as 3), and standing in front of an armed trap 'will repeatedly hit very fast and could be fatal'; swinging logs 6-13; a failed Iban's Lair bridge jump deals 'up to 24 (20% + 5)' and lands you among Soulless; Iban's tomb claw 10; Iban's red spikes about 5-8 each, rapid, not blocked by prayer, with stun and return to the entrance. Any instant teleport can be used to leave. Dying during the doll step means running the whole dungeon again.
facts.caveat: The bridge figure is internally inconsistent ('up to 24' vs '20% + 5', which is about 14-15 at the owner's 48 Hitpoints); use 24 as the conservative bound.
